description.value: Mahtot East Africa Market is an East African-focused supermarket in North Vancouver, recently rebranded from the formerly Persian-oriented Baanou Supermarket. Situated on Sixth Street, it offers touring cyclists a convenient urban provisioning stop with a specialty grocery selection not commonly found at mainstream stores. The neighbourhood location makes it a useful resupply point for riders moving through the North Shore.
